verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rule engine, event triggers, or webhooks. The cited automations are either vendor-defined behaviors or developer building blocks, not a capability for users to author event-triggered rules. Vendor-defined behaviors include payroll automations that gather hours and flag anomalies, and proactive law-change alerts. The developer building blocks are the MCP server and CLI that an external agent could use to prepare payroll.
